'''Ques''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ques system/Legends|Ques system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. 

Ques was located in a [[Star system/Legends|system]] between [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] and the Si'Klaata Cluster, along the [[Ac'fren Spur]] of the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]]. It was the connecting point for ships traveling from [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] toward the Sisar Run.

It was a motley [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] planet at the edge of Hutt Space, typically used by [[Starship/Legends|ships]] heading for the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]]. Outlanders landing at Ques were interrogated extensively, as the Cluster was restricted to [[Outlander]]s.<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
